affine_left_fold_exact_domain: every leaf x-coordinate has an F_p curve lift
for the fixed leaf order, a sign assignment exists whose prefix sums of sizes 2 through 15 are not the identity
every internal u_k is the x-coordinate of the corresponding finite prefix sum

conditional_bridge.forward: A signed relation with all fixed-order prefixes finite projects to the affine left-fold S3 equations.
conditional_bridge.missing_global_stratum: If a required prefix sum is the identity, it has no affine x-coordinate. The repeated-x S3 slice retains only the tangent branch, so a pure affine u_k chain is not globally complete.
conditional_bridge.reverse: After exact base-field lift and local-root recovery, an affine left-fold solution glues to a signed curve relation.

cancellation_pairs: the two x=1 leaves use opposite F_(p^2) lifts
the two x=-1 leaves use opposite F_p lifts
direct_extension_relation.semantic_sum: two opposite-lift pairs cancel and twelve P sum to R

control_field_extension_fiber_witness.meaning: At the exact m, D, control field, factor chain, and membership layer, the direct algebraic signed relation exists over F_(p^2), while the first affine recursive equation has no F_p root.
control_field_extension_fiber_witness.scope: Recovery rejects this tuple because x=1 has no F_p lift. This is a base-field recursive-recovery semantics blocker, not a usable base-field relation and not an S17 evaluation.

direct_relation_witness.scope: Exact intended signed-point relation semantics. S17 is not expanded or evaluated in this certificate.

control_field_m16_counterexample.scope: This is a fixed labeled-topology structural witness at the same m, D, source factor chain, and exact x^D=1 membership layer. It is not the secp256k1 target field and makes no attack-cost claim.

extension_field_membership_witness.meaning: The exact x^D=1 membership layer admits x=1 even though x=1 has no F_5 curve lift. The two identical S3(1,4,z) slices share roots over F_25 but have no root in F_5, so base-field liftability and extension-only fibers require separate recovery checks.
extension_field_membership_witness.scope: Exact membership-layer and resultant-fiber witness only; it is not an on-curve signed relation.

distinct_inputs.meaning: For lifted inputs with x1 != x2, the two roots are the x-coordinates of the sum and difference.

identity_branch.condition: the two lifted points are negatives
identity_branch.consequence: The identity has no affine x-coordinate and cannot be stored in u_k.

direct_relation.semantic_target: there exist signs epsilon_i and epsilon_target in {-1,+1} with sum epsilon_i*P_i + epsilon_target*R = identity

steps: exact signed point tuple with target

glv_normalization.coefficient_rule: if Q=eta*phi^j(P0), an occurrence epsilon*Q contributes epsilon*eta*lambda^j modulo n to P0
glv_normalization.representative_rule: choose the minimum canonical encoding modulo point sign among P, phi(P), and phi^2(P), and retain eta in Q=eta*phi^j(P0)

recovery_contract.identity_prefix_policy: Direct leaf-point recovery may accept an identity prefix, but the affine recursive presentation cannot use it as u_k. Such rows belong to a separate projective/identity stratum.
recovery_contract.multiplicity_policy: Repeated coordinates, opposite signs, permutations, and GLV orbit aliases are canonicalized before rank accounting.

ordered_tree_dynamic_program.backpointers: retain child-state backpointers and exact multiplicities for every surviving parent state
ordered_tree_dynamic_program.identity_state: route A+B=identity to the named non-affine stratum; do not encode it as an affine u_k
ordered_tree_dynamic_program.leaf_states: {P_i,-P_i} after exact F_p lift; reject an empty lift set
ordered_tree_dynamic_program.parent_transition: form every exact A+B, retain it only when nonidentity and x(A+B) equals the supplied internal coordinate
ordered_tree_dynamic_program.root_acceptance: accept exactly the surviving root states R or -R, then apply target normalization

levels: ordered leaf tuple and fixed tree topology
permutation_accounting.recursive_warning: permutation admissibility is topology dependent and must be replayed rather than inferred from the direct coordinate orbit count

permutation_recovery_audit.ordering_rank_definition: lexicographic combinations of the two zero-based positions occupied by repeated_50P
permutation_recovery_audit.relative_sign_convention: the first leaf sign is +1; bit i-1 of sign_mask_tail_15 selects +1 for leaf i and 0 selects -1

recovery_contract.recursive_solution_policy: Reject a raw polynomial solution unless every internal value lifts to the exact recovered finite prefix point and all local signs glue to the final exact group relation.
